title: Clear the Linux failures in the KeePassXC bridge that block the release clippy and tests gates
goal: On Linux x86_64, main ccf7d1d74 failed two release gates in crates/susi-config/src/keepass_bridge.rs. Clippy (-D warnings): an unused mut on the passphrase that only the Windows DPAPI fallback reassigns, and a needless return in the Linux-only detection block; both are now allowed exactly where they apply. Tests: is_susi_wrapper_binary did not recognise a Windows-style path (C:\susi-gpg.exe) on Unix because Path::file_name does not split on a backslash there, so keepass_bridge::tests::gpg_keygrip_parser_git_remediation_and_wrapper_guard_work failed; the last component is now taken after either separator on every platform. No Windows behaviour changes.
limitations: Verified on Linux x86_64 only; the Windows build of this file is unchanged apart from two attributes that are inactive there.
